summary: The proof is complete and correct. The full-chord endpoints are boundary points in the stated cyclic order; the chord-chain argument gives the two claimed closed halfplane containments for the entire P_{k ell} cell. The affine (X,Y)-to-(t,q) change has determinant one, the transformed points and line equations are exact, and the resulting feasible intersection is the stated triangle. Its exact area is 999/196004000000, strictly below the prescribed P_{k ell} area 1/100000000, yielding the required contradiction.
